name: naabu
description: Fast port scanner written in Go with focus on reliability and simplicity, designed for attack surface discovery in bug bounties and pentests

naabu.description: High-performance SYN/CONNECT/UDP port scanner optimized for speed and accuracy with support for multiple output formats
naabu.usage:
naabu -host example.com
naabu -host example.com -port 80,443,8080
naabu -list hosts.txt -port 1-1000
naabu -host example.com -top-ports 100
naabu -host example.com -json -o results.json
naabu -host example.com -exclude-ports 22,80
